dateFilters: None. Historical controlled counterfactuals selected deliberately; not a daily new-publication scan.
resultAccounting: 23 queries across seven batches. No complete database export or unique-result denominator claimed. Ten trial reports retained by design, mechanism contrast and population. Secondary reviews used for navigation only, not aggregate extraction. Unrelated results and individual narratives excluded.
deduplication: DOI and trial identifier; related open-label extensions are not independent confirmations. Drug dose arms sharing placebo not treated as independent studies.
noveltyCheck: README, protocol, STATUS current update, foundation and hypotheses inspected; evidence.jsonl pertinent intervention records and analyses/mns_attrition/report.md reviewed. No scientific-priority or overlooked-literature claim.
access: Web-reader challenges for some PMC/PubMed pages; ordinary anonymous direct HTTP retrieved selected primary sections. Source HTML held only in memory, not saved. Later MNS request challenged after earlier successful retrieval. No bypass, proxy or credentials.
registryLimitations: Eight current snapshots, no history audit. Registry MNS enrollment34 vs paper32 completed and DBS2017 enrollment20 vs paper19 retained as distinct counts, not silently reconciled. No claim missing results means missing publication. MNS home and rTMS registry not identified in bounded pass.
interpretation: Published marginal confidence intervals used descriptively. No pooled effect, cross-age ranking, patient data, simulation, or mechanistic mediation estimate.
privacy: Only original summaries, aggregate numeric inputs, public scholarly identifiers and selected registry metadata retained.
